verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships a built-in MCP server that lets an agent browse issues, inspect stack traces and event data, and resolve, unresolve or ignore issues. That covers pulling and triaging error data. Nothing in the evidence shows GlitchTip filing bugs into an external tracker, and the GitLab integration only shows GlitchTip errors inside GitLab, so that part depends on other tools. missing for 10: native filing of bugs into an issue tracker, documented ranking of top production issues, an OpenAPI/REST API spec (probes returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull my top production issues with stack traces via API or MCP, triage them, and file the real bugs into my tracker

citations.quote: Investigate errors — Browse issues, inspect stack traces and event data, and resolve issues
